# Domain Code Group (DCG)

> شركة تطوير برمجيات سعودية متخصصة في أنظمة ERP والتجارة الإلكترونية وحلول الذكاء الاصطناعي، مقرها الرياض مع حضور في عمّان والدوحة وعدن.

## Core Products

### 1. DomainCode ERP (DomainCode ERP PRO)
Comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning system - one-time purchase, no monthly subscription.

- Full Arabic support with RTL
- ZATCA e-invoicing compliance
- Smart POS integration
- API integration with Salla, Zid
- Modules: Accounting, Buying, Sales/CRM, Manufacturing, Projects, HR, E-commerce

**Packages:**

| Package | Price (SAR) | Maintenance/Year (SAR) | Best For |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|----------|
| Trade Pack (باقة التجارة) | 2,500 | 500 | Small retail, POS-focused |
| Business Basic (باقة الأعمال) | 5,000 | 1,500 | Growing businesses with accounting needs |
| Business Pro (باقة الأعمال Pro) | 8,500 | 2,500 | Companies needing HR & payroll |
| Ultimate Pack (الباقة الاحترافية) | Contact us | 3,500 | Manufacturing, projects, e-commerce |

**URL:** https://domaincodegroup.com/app/dcgERP

### 2. DomainCode Commerce
E-commerce platform designed for the Saudi and GCC market.

- Local payment gateways (Mada, Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay, STC Pay)
- Full RTL Arabic support
- Mobile-first responsive design
- SEO-optimized product pages
- Integration with shipping providers (Aramex, SMSA, DHL)
- Advanced inventory management
- Multi-vendor marketplace capability
- Multi-currency and multi-language support

**Packages:**

| Package | Price (SAR) | Maintenance/Year (SAR) | Best For |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|----------|
| Starter (البداية) | 3,500 | 750 | Up to 500 products, ready-made template |
| Growth (النمو) | 7,500 | 1,800 | Unlimited products, all payment gateways |
| Business (الأعمال) | 14,000 | 3,000 | Multi-vendor, mobile apps, advanced API |
| Enterprise (المؤسسات) | Contact us | 5,000 | Dedicated hosting, ERP integration, B2B, SLA |

**URL:** https://domaincodegroup.com/app/dcgCommerce

### 3. DomainCode AI
Arabic-first AI solutions for enterprises.

- Custom LLM integration for Arabic language
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems
- Document intelligence and analysis
- AI-powered chatbots with Arabic understanding
- Predictive analytics for business
- Computer vision solutions
- Voice recognition in Arabic dialects
- Integration with existing ERP/CRM systems

**Packages:**

| Package | Price (SAR) | Maintenance/Year (SAR) | Best For |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|----------|
| Exploration (الاستكشاف) | 5,000 | 1,000 | Initial consulting + POC |

**URL:** https://domaincodegroup.com/app/dcgAI
